I understand your concern about losing a medication that's helping you, but tremors severe enough to prevent you from working are a significant side effect that your doctor needs to know about right away. This isn't an either/or situation—your doctor may be able to adjust your dosage, switch you to a different medication that also helps your depression, or add something to manage the tremors. There are often multiple options that can treat depression effectively.

Please don't stop taking your medication abruptly, as that can cause withdrawal symptoms or make your depression worse. Contact your doctor as soon as possible and be honest about what's happening. They're there to help you find a solution that works for your overall health, not just one symptom. If you can't reach your doctor soon and the tremors worsen or you experience other concerning symptoms, consider urgent care. You deserve to feel better without side effects that disrupt your daily life.
